_meta.purpose: Question scaffolding for the AIO-Citation Kit FAQ generator (Deliverable 2).
_meta.how_used: These are QUESTION prompts only — never canned answers. The generator hands the relevant set to the model as topic seeds, and uses them directly only as a no-LLM fallback (every fallback answer is flagged 'template — rewrite with real specifics'). Answers are always drafted per-business and gated by a human fact-check.
_meta.rule: Questions must be ones a real local customer would type into ChatGPT/Perplexity. No keyword stuffing, no business-specific facts baked in here.
